iOS 27 adds several new features and changes to Apple Wallet, one of which I've been looking forward to for many years: the ability to import physical tickets.

iOS 27 lets you import physical tickets, membership cards, and event passes into Apple Wallet

Apple Wallet offers a range of features to help you replace your physical wallet and keys.

It can store credit cards, driver's licences, transit cards, boarding passes, event tickets, car keys, home keys, hotel room keys, and more.

And in iOS 27, the Wallet app takes another step toward becoming the only wallet you'll ever need.

Because now you can import physical tickets, passes, membership cards, and more into Apple Wallet.

Here's how Apple says it works:

Digital tickets are far more common now than when Apple Wallet first launched, but not everything is available that way.

I still come across businesses and events that only accept physical tickets, and when I do, it gives me a bit of anxiety, because I have to remember to bring those tickets with me at the right time.

But with iOS 27, everything can start going into the Wallet app, which I'm definitely carrying with me. Putting everything in the Wallet means no more worrying about remembering to bring one more thing.

Have you added any physical tickets to Apple Wallet in iOS 27? Share with us in the comments.
